name: Thatte Idli
steps: Wash and soak idli rice, urad dal and fenugreek for 5 hours. Soak poha briefly and grind it with the drained grains and measured water into a thick, smooth batter.
Cover loosely and ferment overnight until the batter has visibly risen. Gently fold in salt; avoid beating out the air that makes the large idlis soft.
Lightly oil four wide, flat thatte-idli plates. Pour the batter about 2 cm deep into each, leaving a little room at the rim for expansion.
Steam over actively boiling water for 12–15 minutes, until a skewer inserted at the centre comes out clean. Rest for 2 minutes before lifting each broad idli from its plate.
Serve one plate-sized idli per person with warm prepared sambar and coconut chutney. Its broad, flat shape is the defining feature; do not use small round idli moulds.
tips: The batter should be thick enough to rise, but pourable into a flat plate.
passiveTime: Soak grains for 5 hours and ferment overnight.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
